messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — need to swap the roadmap and Q&A order for today's all-hands. Roadmap first, Q&A after. AV says they need ~3min to swap slides. Recording + captions status?
jordan: OK from product side, doing the slide re-order now. Lina can you confirm captions node health?
lina: Captions node in us-west is degraded, I can try a restart. If that fails we'll flip to manual fallback (live-cc).
stream-bot: Recording started by stream-bot — session_id=ah-2171239999, recorder=obs01
mike: Noted. OBS dropped once earlier; if we lose recorder again, fallback to local push: `ffmpeg -f lavfi -i anullsrc -re -i slides.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -b:v 2500k -c:a aac -f flv rtmp://localhost:1935/live/ah`
lina: Thanks @mike — restarting caption service now. Can someone mute audience mics for ~60s during the swap?
sarah: I can mute attendee mics now. @alex are you still running Q&A afterwards or do you want me to lead?
alex: I'll run roadmap + intro, @sarah will handle live Qs. Also please clip the 2min pre-roll from the recording when you upload.
mike: Clip tip: `ffmpeg -ss 00:02:00 -i raw.mp4 -c copy out_trimmed.mp4` or use obs-cli snapshot for quick nudge.
lina: Captions service back after restart. Latency ~12s, accuracy normal. Ready to roll.
jordan: :thumbsup: pushing updated agenda to the slides and the calendar event now.
stream-bot: OBS reconnected (obs01). Ingest: 2.3 Mbps. Recording status: OK.
sarah: For Q&A triage: I'll collect questions in #all-hands-questions and pick the top 12. Ping me if you want a question prioritized.
alex: Small content ask — call out Dedicated capacity roadmap on slide 2. Otherwise green from my side.
lina: Monitoring captions + recorder. Ping me immediately if you notice audio dropouts or clip gaps.
jordan: Thanks all — making the last slide tweak. Meet at stage in 2 mins.
